title: Make installed federation proof terminal tests use controlled deadlines
outcome: Make installed proof cancellation and I/O failure tests independent of the real attestation deadline, and cover the structured timeout result.
acceptance: The installed satellite proof-cancellation and proof I/O failure behavior tests control the attestation I/O clock so that elapsed wall time cannot substitute a timeout for the intended result.

A deterministic installed proof-write timeout check verifies exact withdrawal, stage attest, reason tagWriteExpired, null I/O kind and the existing service-unavailable response, with the terminal reason kept after teardown.
